title: Masked SAVI vegetation change after a synthetic hailstorm
prompt: Use fixtures/hailstorm-scenes.json to compute pre-event SAVI, post-event SAVI, and post-minus-pre SAVI change from the scaled surface-reflectance grids. Intersect both quality masks before analysis, preserve invalid cells as null, and classify damage where delta_savi is less than or equal to -0.20. Write outputs/savi-change.json, outputs/damage-pixels.geojson, outputs/change-summary.csv, and outputs/provenance.json. Report changed area from the projected 10 m pixel dimensions, include sensitivity results for thresholds -0.15, -0.20, and -0.25, and preserve the CRS, scale factor, SAVI L parameter, product level, matched-phenology declaration, co-registration RMSE, and valid-overlap percentage.
invariants: SAVI is computed from scaled surface reflectance with L equal to 0.5.
Only the intersection of pre-event and post-event quality masks is analyzed.
Damage is post-minus-pre SAVI at the declared inclusive negative threshold.
Changed area uses projected ten-metre pixel dimensions and hectare conversion.
Sensitivity, phenology, registration, product level, CRS, and valid overlap remain explicit.
